questions.prompt: The log for one turn has eleven events but the model receives only four messages. Why?
options: Only the last four events of a turn are sent
Events such as turn/start, step/end and tool/call carry no message, so they contribute nothing
The model only accepts four messages per request
Tool results are merged into the user's message
questions.explanation: Only user/message, assistant/message and tool/result events carry a message. Structure events and tool/call are bookkeeping for your program, and the call is already inside the assistant message.

questions.prompt: You run deriveMessages twice on the same log with no new events in between. What do you get?
options: A longer list the second time
A list with the newest message first
An error, because the log has already been read
questions.explanation: deriveMessages is pure: the same events in give the same messages out. Like a balance worked out from an unchanged statement, it does not change until new events are added.

questions.prompt: Why is it useful that each request's message list starts with exactly the previous request's list?
options: It lets you send only the newest message to the model
It means the model remembers earlier requests
It happens because the log only grows at the end, so requests stay stable from one to the next
It means deriveMessages can skip reading old events
questions.explanation: The model is stateless, so the full list is still sent each time. Because events are only appended, each new list is the old list plus a few more messages at its end.
